newsitem.title: INDIA: PowerGen, India Birla power plant approved.
newsitem.headline: PowerGen, India Birla power plant approved.

text.p: Bina Power Supply Company, a joint venture power company between India's Aditya Birla Group and Britain's PowerGen Plc has received final clearance from government authorities, the Indian group said on Friday.
"Bina Power has received the final techno-economic clearance from the Central Electricity Authority," it said.
The coal-fired plant is designed to produce 578 MW.

"The final clearance is at a cost of 24.43 billion rupees. Most of the other clearances have been received including pollution clearance, environmental clearance from the central (federal) government, fuel linkage for coal and rail linkage for transportation of coal," it said in a statement.
A letter of intent for engineering, procurement and construction has been issued to a consortium led by Siemens and Bharat Heavy Electricals, it said.
Financing of the project is expected to be completed by September 1997.

A major portion of the funds will be raised locally, it said. The Aditya Birla Group will own 27 percent and PowerGen 26 percent of Bina Power, it said. It did not say who would hold the balance shareholding.
Power generated by Bina Power will be sold to the Madhya Pradesh Electricity Board.
